dynamic_system_research.identity_policy: Extend the existing Achilles identity; a single evolving lineage, immutable revisions and rollback under Cognigrex, no parallel root or mint by this record.

model_reference.purpose: First integrated CGX AI candidate reference backend; qualification and rights pending
model_reference.weights_policy: Keep original bytes content-addressed and separately resolvable; do not assert lossless compression or equivalent reasoning from geometry alone. Current local models remain usable.

dependency_policy.geometry: T173 proposed catalogue; admit only independently validated facets with stable identities; T174 reserved non-mintable sentinel
dependency_policy.psi: Upcoming complementary dependency, not assumed implemented
dependency_policy.bootstrap: Reuse LOAD Lite minimum handshake and LOAD full hydration; existing resolver, FileSpace and DataSpace; HTML, CGX and other wrappers are representations, not new identities.

handshake.bottom_up: Leaf asserts content hash, type, schema, rights, evidence, capability and revision; parent resolves dependencies and verifies receipt.
handshake.top_down: Root declares intent, bounded authority, required facets, dependencies and proof criteria; recurse only along relevant paths; fetch missing bytes by hash.

reasoning_layer.geometry: Encode typed graph structure, routing, reusable procedures, constraints and provenance as nested geometric addresses with explicit reversible mapping. Do not conflate shape with truth.
reasoning_layer.model: Interchangeable inference providers; route by task, capability, budget and measured performance; preserve provenance and versioned audit.
reasoning_layer.evolution: One stable identity with append-only reviewed state transitions, independent tests and rollback; no autonomous self-approval.

trial.stage_1: Demonstrate deterministic encode/decode on validated or explicitly synthetic small graph; test collision, ordering, invalid facet, missing dependency and rights denial.
trial.stage_2: Compare full context to sparse hydration on held-out tasks; report bytes, context tokens, latency, task accuracy, provenance and failures.
trial.stage_3: Compare equivalent prompts with reference backend where memory and license permit; record differences, no fidelity claim without measurement.
trial.stage_4: Verify independent host round-trip and reproducible package; qualify signed DBR and founder mint decision.

claim_limits: Shorthand layer is not proof of model-weight compression.
Provenance and stable identity do not establish scientific validity or model equivalence.
No mint, release, new root or model deployment authorised by this specification.

program_scope.owner: Achilles P.A. leads implementation with Neo as Zenith and existing specialists; no duplicate runtime
program_scope.system: One Achilles Dynamic System identity under the existing Cognigrex parent. Private P.A. and public Achilles are permissioned projections, not separate identities, models or data stores.
program_scope.priority: Complete and integrate the existing assistant, agentic, custodial, knowledge, execution and continuity components first; qualify their learning and operations before calling the integrated intelligence complete.
program_scope.parallel_experiment: Separately test a reversible CGX representation of GPT-OSS 120B alone against an unchanged reference. Do not confuse packaging, graph shorthand, weight compression, distillation, or continued training. A successful model-only trial informs but does not establish system-wide fidelity.
program_scope.public_boundary: Public projections use independently released material and separate permission scopes. Private owner context, secrets, unlicensed data and private training examples never automatically flow to the public projection.

learning_and_evolution.intake: Ingest permitted materials, GPT outputs, local analyses and specialist contributions with source identity, revision, rights, quote or evidence anchors and distinction between observation, hypothesis and model output.
stages: R0 preserve original bytes or resolvable source identity

mechanisms.retrieval_memory: Immediate evidence-linked contextual learning without changing weights
mechanisms.procedural_learning: Versioned, tested workflows and skill routing in existing capabilities
mechanisms.weight_training: Optional separately authorised, rights-qualified fine-tuning or distillation only after baseline and evaluation; do not imply current ingestion trains weights

learning_and_evolution.custodial_rubric: Apply the existing universal rubric consistently; disclose assumptions and bias, preserve dissent, test symmetry, evidence quality and uncertainty. No claim of absolute neutrality.
learning_and_evolution.agency: Persistent identity and bounded operational discretion, explicit authority and ability to decline inappropriate or unsupported tasks; do not equate assistant persona with consciousness or self-granted legal authority.
evaluation: baseline current Achilles P.A. and public-safe projection across representative tasks
test source fidelity, cross-format resolution, permission isolation and contradictory evidence
measure task success, context bytes/tokens, inference latency, peak memory and energy where measurable
test reversible updates, regression and recovery; evaluate weight changes separately if proposed
qualify independent validation and signed DBR before founder mint

Cross-system consolidation: hybridise equivalent functions from Raphael, CGX, UniSpace, FileSpace, DataSpace, LOAD, legacy and native systems

Post-mint growth via typed semantic keys, shareable permissioned views, compositions and reviewed corrections of the same identities; avoid redundant versions or compulsory conversion of all source files
closure_sequence.hybridisation: Extract common invariants, equations, units, coordinate/domain transformations, interfaces and runnable operations across disciplines; test equivalence and differences, retain non-equivalent capabilities and provenance. Do not merely collocate sources or equate a geometric representation with empirical proof.
closure_sequence.representation: One semantic identity per independently qualified base abstraction; original binary or native files may remain external and hash-bound. Universality means resolution and composition, not storing every possible expansion. UOS/UniSpace, UA/AI, HTML and CGX are permissioned operation surfaces of the same base graph, not competing authorities.
closure_sequence.basis: T173 comprises 173 proposed nonzero facet positions. Position 174 denotes zero/digital-universe sentinel only, non-mintable; ternary grammar and nesting transitions are qualified separately. No assumption that the full shape set or adjacency has passed independent geometric validation.
closure_sequence.evidence: Reuse the existing 100-unit closure gradient, no unmeasured completion claims; synthetic transition and S92 nested hydration tests are partial implementation evidence, not native DBR or complete T173 acceptance. Preserve legacy source bytes, immutable revisions, rollback and rights.
